business.what_it_does: Company provides life insurance, pension, savings, health and group insurance products to individuals and institutions in India.

segments.what: Participating life, pension and variable insurance products for individuals.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Q4 FY26 reported revenue fell 82.4% YoY to ₹4,071 crore despite management claiming 13% annual APE growth.
PAT growth narrative matches financials, with Q1 FY27 reported PAT of ₹725 crore growing 22.1% YoY.
Cash flow claims align with financials, showing strong Mar 2026 OCF of ₹34,523 crore and 13.98 OCF/PAT.

bull: Zero debt maintained on balance sheet from Mar 2022 through Sep 2026.
Met FY26 APE growth target at 13% while holding VoNB margin in 26%-28% range.
Strong 5-year operating cash conversion ratio of 13.96x PAT with ₹34,523 crore OCF in Mar 2026.
bear: Quarterly revenue exhibits extreme volatility, contracting 82.4% YoY in Mar 2026.
EBITDA margin crashed to negative 26.0% in Mar 2026 with ₹1,046 crore loss.
VoNB margin sits at lower end of guidance at 26.2% in Q1 FY27.
watch: Margin expansion toward upper 28% range in coming FY27 quarters.
Full year FY27 Individual Rated Premium growth against 14%-15% target.
Quarterly EBITDA margin stability following Mar 2026 operating loss.
